title: OpenAI-compatible providers can omit usage and crash the adapter
body:
## Summary
OpenAI's SDK types `usage` as optional. When a compatible provider omits it (or returns `null`), Chat Completions crashes with `AttributeError` (`None.prompt_tokens`) and Responses fails with a wrapped `TypeSafeError` that hides the cause.

This should be a failed evaluation (`TypeSafeError`) so `error.debug` (`llm_attempts`, `llm_response`) is preserved, instead of leaking a raw `AttributeError` or treating unknown token cost as success.

Official OpenAI still sends usage, so this is a no-op on the happy path. Missing usage is not retried.

I can't open a PR: the repo restricts PRs to collaborators. Fix is on my fork:

https://github.com/salignatmoandal/system-one-adapter-python/tree/fix/openai-optional-usage

Happy to have a maintainer open the PR from that branch, or to get collaborator access.

## Test plan
- `uv run --python 3.13 pytest tests/test_openai_optional_usage.py tests/test_provider_requests.py`
- Chat Completions and Responses raise `TypeSafeError` matching `omitted usage` when `usage` is omitted or `null`
- `error.debug["llm_attempts"]` has one recorded attempt and `debug["llm_response"]` is present
- A normal OpenAI response with usage still succeeds

title: Chat Completions accepts finish_reason="length" as a successful typed evaluation
body:
## Summary

At `adffc2eab300a4fa3c0e92252d4ffd6ceaa53700`, the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions provider accepts token-truncated output when the returned prefix happens to be schema-valid. Sync and async clients are affected.

## Expected behavior

Provider-declared incomplete output must not be exposed as a successful authoritative evaluation. The sibling OpenAI Responses path rejects statuses other than `completed`, and the Anthropic path rejects `stop_reason="max_tokens"` even when text is valid JSON.

## Actual behavior

The shared Chat `_result()` records `finish_reason` in debug data but never checks it. A response with `finish_reason="length"` and valid `{"answers":{"positive":true}}` is returned successfully.

## Reproduction

```sh
cd repositories/system-one-adapter-python
uv run pytest -q ../../artifacts/system-one-adapter-python-audit/test_chat_truncation.py
```

Observed: exit 1, `2 failed, 2 passed`. Both sync and async `length` cases fail with `DID NOT RAISE TypeSafeError`. Otherwise-identical `finish_reason="stop"` controls pass.

The harness exercises public adapter clients and the actual OpenAI SDK HTTP parser using an in-memory HTTP response. It makes no network or paid model call.

## Impact

A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint or explicitly selected Chat Completions API can return a successful typed result even though the provider says generation stopped at its output-token limit. This bypasses malformed/incomplete-output error handling. Frequency against live providers was not measured.

## Root cause

`src/system_one_adapter/providers/openai.py:44-50` records but ignores `response.choices[0].finish_reason`; both sync and async Chat paths call it.

## Suggested fix and regression test

Reject non-success Chat finish reasons before returning `ProviderResult`, while retaining request/response debug metadata. Cover at least `length` and `content_filter` in sync and async tests, with `stop` controls.

## Duplicate check

All 33 issue/PR records, 32 PRs, issue comments, inline comments, formal reviews, timelines, and patches were inspected. Fresh searches covered `finish_reason`, exact `length`, provider filename, Chat truncation, output limits, incomplete completion, and synonyms. PR #1 discusses retry token accounting, not provider-declared incomplete Chat output.
